buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Only supply of Goods 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses I. Financial Criteria: Since the 70% of the estimated value is less than 25.00 Lakh, hence financial criteria exempted /non-appli cable as per note A(I) of O & M /procedure/1001, dated 15.03.2012 II. Experience Criteria:

1) The bidder should have experience of having successfully completed similar orders during any one of t he last five years ending last day of the month previous to the one in which tenders are invited should be either of the following: a) Three similar completed orders, each valuing not less than the amount equal to 9.69 Lakh of the referen ce value. OR b) Two similar completed orders, each valuing not less than the amount equal to 12.93 Lakh of the referen ce value. OR c) One similar completed order valuing not less than the amount equal to 19.39 Lakh of the reference valu e. **********Note************ Similar order mentioned above means "supply of Water Cooled Cable of length minimum 7500mm with co pper cross section of minimum 5000 sq mm". *************************** 2) The experience should be from Indian Govt. Organizations, PSUs or Public Limited Companies. III. Capability Criteria The vendor should be able to execute the following: 1. The Water cooled cables should be strictly made as per the dimensions provided in the specification. 2. The end of the copper stranded wire shall be pressed tightly before entering the connector,then the co pper stranded wire with same direction should be entered to the connector oneby one, and be pressed tig htly from connector. 3. Water pressure test of 1.0MPa shall be carried out after assembly, guarantee 30 mins without leakage . 4. Storage water should be removed with compressed air after leakage test, and plug shall be installed. 5. The conducting surface shall be pained antirust paint, and be protected with dressing. 6. In support of eligibility and experience the tenderer is required to submit self-attested photocopies of d ocuments viz. Purchase Orders and corresponding Supply Invoice/ Excise Duty Gate Pass/Completion Certificate, Performance Certificate etc. 7. Manufacturers Test Certificates, Guarantee/Warranty Certificates are to be submitted along with Material. Other Terms: 1. Transit Damages: To Supplier's Account. 2. Delivery Basis: FOR BSP Stores, Bhilai. 3. PAYMENT TERMS: 100% PAYMENT AGAINST GRN 4. Price shall remain firm till the completion of the order.

OTHER CRITERIA How to Prepare & Submit Bids: Offers are to be necessarily prepared and sub mitted in two parts as detaile d hereunder: Part-1: Techno-Commercial Bid Part-2: Price Bid SECURITY DEPOSIT: Submission of Security Deposit: On acceptance of the offer/bid, the successful bidder shall submit Security Deposit of 3% of the contract value of the PO (excluding taxes & duties), either in the form of Demand Draft / Pay Order / Banker's Cheque OR Bank Guarantee within the period of 30 days from the date of Purc hase Order. In case the supplier/contractor delays submission of Security Deposit / Performance Guarantee, a penalty o f 0.2% of the original SD / PG amount per completed day of delay, limited to an amount not exceeding 5% of the original SD / PG amount shall be applicable. Payment for executed portion of order/contract should only commence on submission of requisite SD/PG. The stamp paper used for the Bank Guarantee shall be of the appropriate value and should be purchased on behalf of the issuing bank and issuance of amendment /extension of Bank Guarantee should also be ma de on stamp paper of appropriate value purchased in the name of the bank. Contact details and address of the issuing branch must be available in the bank guarantee. Validity – Validity: Security Deposit (in the form of BG) should be valid for a period covering the contractua l delivery period plus six months from last date of Delivery Period mentioned in the Purchase Order. Howev er, the claim period of the BG will be 02 months, after expiry of the original validity of the Bank Guarantee. Failure for submission of Security Deposit: Failure to submit Security Deposit within the period specified, w ill constitute a breach of the contract and Purchaser shall be entitled to forfeit the EMD and to take alterna te procurement action at the risk and cost of the supplier. Interest –No claim shall lie against SAIL BHILAI STEEL PLANT either in respect of interest on Security Depos it or depreciation in value. Return of SD – On due performance and completion of the contract in all respects, Security Deposit shall b e returned to the supplier without any interest. IV. All other commercial terms & conditions shall be as per SAIL P1 (October 2023) which is available at SAIL Tenders website https://sailtenders.co.in/ OTHER COMMERCIAL TERMS & CONDITIONS A. Bidder has to quote for full tendered quantity. B. PAYMENT TERMS: 100% PAYMENT AGAINST GRN. C. Submission of offer against the current tender, will construe that vendors have understood and complie d with the statutory provisions applicable for the CPSE’s which inter-alia includes Make In India, MSE, Land Border, Start Up India etc. as per extant guidelines of GOI.

D. “It may be noted that all post order activities (that is regularizing SAP order, material receipts & GRN, B ill processing and any other post order activity) shall be done outside GeM over SAIL BSP’s SAP.” E. Delivery Price Basis: FOR BSP STORES (all-inclusive of transportation, insurance, taxes etc.). F. Price Evaluation will be done on Total value wise.
